title: Pick albums, people and tags from tiles instead of typing UUIDs
summary: The admin UI has a "What to show" tab that lists albums, people and tags straight from Immich as tiles with cover photos. Tap what you want, press Save. The API key stays on the server.

title: Name your accounts
summary: Accounts get an optional name that is shown in the admin UI instead of "Account 1", "Account 2".

screenshots.caption: The account switcher on "What to show"

title: Admin split into "What to show" and "Settings" tabs
summary: Content selection and display settings are separate tabs, and the "Saved" notice can be closed (and goes away by itself).

title: Light / dark mode switch in the admin UI
summary: The admin UI follows your browser's light or dark theme by default. The sun/moon button in the header switches it, and your choice is remembered on that device.

screenshots.caption: After pressing the switch: light mode (the other screenshots default to dark)

title: "Refresh photos now"
summary: One button clears everything ImmichFrame cached from Immich and makes running frames drop their queued photos. Changing the picked albums/people/tags does the same automatically, and frames re-check their config every 2 minutes, so changes show up without reloading the frame.

title: Tap-zone controls for touch screens
summary: New `TouchZoneControls` setting. The slideshow is split into three invisible tap zones: left = back, middle = pause/play, right = next. Works with mouse clicks too. (The dashed outlines in the screenshot are drawn for illustration only.)

title: Admin checkboxes are easier to read
summary: Checkbox labels now sit next to their boxes, and the checkboxes are grouped after the other fields (with a heading in each account card) instead of being scattered through the form.

screenshots.caption: Checkboxes grouped with labels beside them

title: Display settings apply without reloading the frame
summary: Running frames re-check their configuration every 2 minutes, so a changed setting shows up on its own instead of needing a browser reload.
